positive_cases.expect: each end keeps the row frame and removes material (taper and round are smaller than square)
the deep end is at the last stone; Flip moves it to the first
the same body (the flip cannot change a symmetric channel)
one extra station and a larger volume

negative_cases.case: an end depth below the minimum

limitations: Mirror picks the wider of the two end profiles for both ends and the deeper of the two caps; it does not invent a third profile.
Flip swaps A and B; the A/B ends are the first and last station of the row as selected, so the selection order is the orientation.
The manual's profile IDs are mapped to three typed end profiles (Square, Round, Taper); a user profile library is not part of this owner.
